name: Hemonculus

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Familiar block (CR 1). Bond ritual: 10 minutes with materials worth 100+ gp (fresh blood and gem dust); the Familiar Bond rules (bonded sympathy, channel magic, telepathic connection, 1-hour revival) are on page 580 and are listed once in the notes file.

traits.name: Blood Sense
traits.summary: Knows where any Bloodied creature within 60 ft is, unless it is a Construct or Undead.
traits.text: The hemonculus knows the location of every Bloodied creature within 60 feet that isn't a Construct or Undead.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.summary: Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Claw
actions.summary: +5, 1d4+3 Slashing plus 1d6 Necrotic; it attaches, and while attached its Claw attacks against that target hit automatically.
actions.text: Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage, and the hemonculus attaches to the target. While attached its Claw attacks against that target automatically hit. It detaches by spending 5 feet of movement; the target or a creature within 5 feet of it can pull it off as an action.

actions.name: Exsanguinate
actions.summary: Once a day: 15-ft emanation, creatures of its choice make a DC 13 Con save or take 3d6 Necrotic (half on a success) and can't regain Hit Points until its next turn; if it is attached to a victim it regains HP equal to that victim's Necrotic damage.

summary: A blood-formed fiendling that clings to a victim and drains it, spies out the wounded, and slips away from reach.
